answer: Cluster-wide witness quotas: cap influence by fingerprint. Each account's timing entropy, routing pattern and hardware profile hash into one cluster id, and all accounts sharing it draw a single witness slot per epoch, not one each. No relic of manual review - the index recomputes every checkpoint. Puppet value peaks at its zenith with the first account: a cluster holding its slot gains nothing from further duplicates, so each extra puppet pays real cost for zero influence. Honest agents on a long horizon pay one slot's diligence once; dilution never amortizes.
